Higgsfield is best known for what the company calls a visual reasoning engine for generating and editing media – especially cinematic video, images and voice/audio – using text prompts or references.
Today you open Higgsfield and you can run Google Veo, Kling, Seedance, their own models, whatever is best, side by side, in parallel.
